question.prompt: There are 13 candies, packed with 5 candies in each bag. Write the quotient first, then the remainder. Quotient and remainder: \(13 \div 5\)

solutions.explanation: \(13 \div 5 = 2\) (bags) with remainder 3. The remainder 3 is smaller than the divisor 5.
solutions.title: Find full bags and leftovers
